description:
## Goal

The three always-available meta-tools that let the agent pull surfaces on demand at negligible token cost (3 small tool defs instead of dumping every scenario's tools into context).

## Expected Work

- Implement `search_tools(query)`, `search_commands(query)`, `search_widgets(query)` per research JSON-Schema.
- Wire them into the default prompt for auto-mode chats.
- Query the unified index.
- Return result payloads rich enough for the agent to decide whether to invoke.
- Track token-cost and call frequency as observability signals.

## Acceptance

- Agent can discover and invoke a previously-unsurfaced tool by calling one of the three meta-tools.
- Token cost of the three meta-tools in context is bounded and measurable.
name: agent-inbox-agent-led-search-tools
title: Ship `search_tools` / `search_commands` / `search_widgets` meta-tools
